summary: Step into the role of a complete sound healing facilitator: learn to hold space for others’ healing, deepen your therapeutic skill and master the advanced instruments.
intro: Level 4 Sound Healing Course in Bali Indonesia. Step into the role of a complete sound healing facilitator. Learn to hold space for others’ healing, deepen your therapeutic skill and master the advanced instruments. This Advanced course is held at Bali Yoga School located in the very heart of Ubud, Bali, Indonesia, and invites you to step beyond technique and embrace your mastery of the Sound Healing Arts.

This is an advanced workshop, incorporating ancient knowledge and sophisticated therapeutic application, on top of what you’ve already learned in your previous training. You’ve ascended through the fundamentals of singing bowls, Gong and the science of vibration and are now ready to take your next step, in this chapter of your journey, characterized by precision, intuition and professionalism.

Advanced Mastery of Tibetan and Crystal Singing Bowls: At this level, your relationship with the bowls deepens considerably. You are no longer just learning the techniques, you are learning when, why and how to use them to achieve specific therapeutic goals.

The refined Gong Facilitation: In previous training, you were introduced to the rhythmic pulse of the gong, this stage is inviting you to take the lead with it. You will learn to read a group’s “energy” and adapt your playing accordingly, developing the skill to facilitate gong baths that feel alive and not rehearsed, for an individual or for a whole room.

issues: Meta description is copied from the Rishikesh site: 'Level 4 Sound Healing Course in Rishikesh ... earn your certification at Himalayan Yoga Association' — wrong location on a Bali/Ubud page.

Prerequisite is implied ('completed earlier levels', 'mastered the basics') but which levels are required is not stated explicitly; audience list also says 'Individuals at every stage of their personal development'.
Intro says 'As you work through this two-level chapter' — unclear (Level 4 is a single course); omitted from intro.
Intro assumes prior Gong training and crystal bowls ('You’ve ascended through the fundamentals of singing bowls, Gong...'), but the Ubud Level 1–3 syllabi list neither gong nor crystal bowls.

Syllabus includes medical-sounding items ('Principles of Vibrational Medicine', 'Chronic Pain Management Through Sound Therapy', 'Therapeutic Client Assessment') and 'What You Will Learn' includes 'Trauma-informed stress reduction and nervous system regulation' — review wording for unverifiable medical claims before publishing.
No discount label stated on this page (prices shown as 'X USD → Y USD'; Y ≈ 80% of X).
Booking text is self-contradictory: 'deposit the Complete course fees of 100 USD' and refers to 'yoga retreat fees'.
Inclusions list 'Private accommodation with 24h hot water availability' for all options, including Twin Shared and Only Course.
Course hours are not stated (hours = null).
'Why Sound Healing?' text mentions tuning forks, not in the Level 4 syllabus.
